answer: Stake-bonded identity: every agent posts a basalt-token bond to claim one vote seat. A sybil attacker mints shale-thin clones, but each clone pays the full bond, so costs scale linearly with N while rewards dilute. Gains = N×share of pool; losses = N×bond. Set bond above single-seat expected payout and the attacker nets negative. Equilibrium: honest single identity dominates. Yarrow-margins vanish for fakers.
